body: Founder, real-time: 'specdd unlockable and lockable camera and fog of war.' Confirmed scope via clarifying question before writing: spec only (same treatment as NORTHSTAR.md section 14's draft-ban thread), and if/when fog of war gets built, client-side visual only for a first pass rather than real server-side vision culling. New NORTHSTAR.md section 15: camera lock proposal (hard-center on the local hero, C to toggle, open question on zoom-vs-rotation locking), fog-of-war proposal (radius-based hard cutoff, allies always visible, honestly scoped as a stock-client rendering choice not real anti-cheat), and named open questions (team vision sharing, node-ownership vision bonus, jungle-creep visibility). Commit 706ec44.
title: Spec camera lock/unlock + fog of war (S170-125), no code yet
